title: Video KYC Verification Policy and Document Requirements
content: Customers completing Video KYC must have their original physical PAN card ready, Aadhaar registered mobile number for OTP verification, a smartphone or camera device in a well-lit environment, and a blank white sheet with a dark pen for live signature capture. Video KYC verification sessions take approximately 2 to 5 minutes once connected with a KYC officer. Photocopied, laminated, or digital screenshots of the PAN card are strictly rejected under RBI KYC guidelines. Once completed, full account privileges activate within 1 hour.

title: Savings Account Opening, Balance Inquiry and Privacy Policy
content: For privacy and security reasons, account balances, recent transaction history, and downloadable statements are not disclosed directly over automated voice menus unless verified via authenticated backend tools. Customers can check real-time balances and mini-statements immediately via the official Mobile Banking App, Internet Banking, or missed-call SMS alerts from their registered mobile number. Branch counters operate Monday to Friday 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM and on the 1st, 3rd, and 5th Saturdays.

title: Savings Account Minimum Average Balance (MAB) and Shortfall Charges
content: Monthly Average Balance (MAB) requirements depend on branch location: Metro and Urban branches require ₹10,000 MAB; Semi-Urban branches require ₹5,000 MAB; Rural branches require ₹2,000 MAB. If the balance falls below the threshold, a proportional shortfall charge between ₹150 to ₹400 plus GST is levied at month-end. Salary accounts and Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY) accounts have zero minimum balance requirements with zero penalty. Customers receive an SMS alert 10 days before any shortfall fee is deducted, allowing time to replenish funds.

title: Savings Account Interest Calculation and Quarterly Credit Schedule
content: Savings account interest is calculated on a daily product basis using the day-end balance and is credited to customer accounts at the end of each calendar quarter (30th June, 30th September, 31st December, and 31st March). Slabs: Daily balance up to ₹1 Lakh earns 3.00% p.a.; balance from ₹1 Lakh to ₹10 Lakhs earns 3.50% p.a.; balance exceeding ₹10 Lakhs earns 4.00% p.a. Under Income Tax Section 80TTA, interest earned up to ₹10,000 per financial year is exempt from tax for individuals under 60.

title: Inactive and Dormant Account Reactivation Guidelines
content: A bank account is classified as Inactive if no customer-induced transaction occurs for 12 continuous months, and becomes Dormant or Inoperative after 24 months. While dormant, debit cards, UPI, and ATM transactions are restricted to safeguard funds. To reactivate a dormant account, the account holder must visit their home branch with original KYC documents (PAN, Aadhaar/Passport) and complete biometric or physical verification. Reactivation is completely free of charge under RBI guidelines, and full account operations are restored within 24 hours.

title: Form 15G and Form 15H Submission for TDS Exemption on Deposits
content: Customers whose total annual taxable income is below the basic exemption threshold can submit Form 15G (for individuals below 60 years) or Form 15H (for senior citizens aged 60 and above) to prevent Tax Deducted at Source (TDS) on interest from Fixed and Recurring Deposits. The threshold for TDS deduction is ₹40,000 for general citizens and ₹50,000 for senior citizens under Section 194A. Forms can be submitted digitally via Mobile Banking or NetBanking in April at the start of the financial year, or submitted physically at any branch.

title: Account Nomination Registration, Modification, and Deceased Claim Settlement
content: Every individual account holder can nominate one person per account using Form DA-1. Nominees can be added, modified, or cancelled anytime via Mobile Banking under Profile Settings or at the home branch. In the unfortunate event of an account holder's demise, the registered nominee can claim the balance without succession certificate by submitting the original death certificate, nominee KYC documents, and claim settlement form DA-2. Banks settle undisputed deceased claims within 15 calendar days.

title: Joint Account Operational Mandates and Mode of Operation
content: Joint accounts can be opened with up to 4 holders under several operating mandates: 'Either or Survivor' (E or S) where either person can operate the account and withdraw funds independently; 'Former or Survivor' (F or S) where only the primary holder operates while living and the survivor gains control on demise; 'Jointly' where all signatures are required for withdrawals. Mobile Banking and NetBanking viewing access can be granted to each joint holder individually.

title: Fixed Deposit (FD) Tenures, Senior Citizen Rates, and Premature Closure
content: Fixed Deposits (FD) offer guaranteed returns across tenures from 7 days to 10 years. Senior citizens aged 60 and above receive an additional 0.50% interest rate across all tenures, and super senior citizens (80+) receive an additional 0.75%. Premature withdrawal is permitted for liquidity; the interest rate payable will be 0.50% to 1.00% below the contracted rate or the rate applicable for the actual period run. Auto-renewal can be configured for principal plus interest or principal only.

title: Tax Saver 5-Year Fixed Deposit Policy and Section 80C Benefits
content: Tax Saver Fixed Deposits have a mandatory lock-in period of 5 years and qualify for tax deduction under Section 80C of the Income Tax Act up to ₹1,50,000 per financial year. Premature withdrawal, sweep-in, and loan or overdraft against a tax saver FD are strictly prohibited during the 5-year lock-in period. Interest can be paid monthly, quarterly, or compounded on maturity.

title: Recurring Deposit (RD) Monthly Installment Rules and Late Charges
content: Recurring Deposits allow disciplined monthly savings starting from ₹500 per month for tenures from 6 months to 120 months. Monthly installments are auto-debited on a fixed date. A grace period of 5 days is allowed for depositing monthly installments. If an installment is delayed past the grace period, a late fee of ₹1.50 per ₹100 per month is charged. Failure to pay 4 consecutive installments may lead to premature closure of the RD account.

title: Passbook Printing Kiosks, Duplicate Issuance, and Digital m-Passbook
content: Customers can print physical passbooks 24x7 using automated barcode passbook printing kiosks at all branch e-lobbies. Digital m-Passbook is available inside the Mobile Banking app and lets customers view and search past 12 months transactions offline without branch visits. If a physical passbook is lost or filled, a duplicate or continuation passbook is issued at the home branch for ₹100 upon submitting an application.

title: Cheque Book Issuance, Stop Payment, and Positive Pay System (PPS)
content: Cheque books containing 20, 50, or 100 leaves can be ordered via Mobile Banking, NetBanking, or branch request. The first 20 leaves per financial year are free. Stop payment of an issued cheque can be executed instantly online or via IVR for a service fee of ₹100 per cheque. Under RBI Positive Pay System (PPS) guidelines, customers issuing cheques exceeding ₹50,000 must pre-confirm key details (cheque number, date, payee name, amount) via app or NetBanking to prevent clearing fraud.

title: Mobile Number, Email ID, and Communication Address Update Protocol
content: To update registered mobile number or email address, customers must authenticate via Debit Card and OTP at any bank ATM, complete biometric validation at their home branch, or use DigiLocker in NetBanking. For communication address changes, customers can submit an Officially Valid Document (Aadhaar, Passport, Voter ID, Driving Licence) online via Aadhaar OTP or at any branch. Updates reflect across banking systems within 24 hours.

title: Doorstep Banking Services (DSB) for Senior Citizens and Differently Abled
content: Senior citizens aged 70 years and above, differently-abled persons, and visually impaired individuals are provided Doorstep Banking (DSB) services at their residence. Services include cash pickup and delivery up to ₹25,000, cheque collection, life certificate submission (Jeevan Pramaan), Form 15G/15H collection, and account statement delivery. Bookings can be made via the Doorstep Banking App or toll-free helpline 1800-1037-188.
